Streets, schools and getting around City of Mission

items.t: The page's four named plan areas (Cedar Valley, Downtown Mission, Silverdale, Stave Heights) are City plan areas, NOT board sub-areas. The Fraser Valley board community "Mission" has nine sub-areas: Dewdney Deroche, Durieu, Hatzic, Hemlock, Lake Errock, Mission, Mission West, Stave Falls and Steelhead — so no board figure describes any plan area.
The City of Mission sits on the north side of the Fraser River, bounded by the Fraser River to the south, the District of Maple Ridge to the west, and FVRD electoral areas to the north and east.

faq.q: How big is the Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area?
faq.a: 1,392 ha (3,440 ac) inside the City's urban growth boundary, bordered by Silverdale Creek to the east, Silvermere Lake to the west and the Fraser River and ALR lands to the south, per the City's SCPA Neighbourhood Planning Terms of Reference (Policy LAN.64(C), adopted February 18, 2020).

faq.q: How did Mission sell in September 2026?
faq.a: At board community level: 231 detached listings with 28 sold (median $814,000, $353/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 29 days on market) and 122 Condos & Townhomes listings with 10 sold (median $430,000, $368/sq ft, 95%, 61 days); the urban Mission sub-area recorded 23 of the 28 detached sales and all 10 attached sales. No plan-area figures exist in the permitted source (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: When were City of Mission property taxes due in 2026, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: Due Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a 10% penalty added to any current balances outstanding (including unclaimed home owner grants) on July 3, 2026; the City states it has no authority to waive or modify the penalty.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in City of Mission Land Use Plans?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Do I own the land in a Mission park?
faq.a: No. You own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad — your right to the site is the assigned pad tenancy under the MHPTA.

Through the Manufactured Home Registry — the sale is only effective once registered, filed by a lawyer or notary with the signed Bill of Sale and Notice to Transfer or Change Ownership; the CSA label must be attached at point of sale.
